findings.title: Tinker report filename convention drift: report-tinker-YYYY-* vs report-YYYY-* coexist
findings.description: The 2026-07-08/07-09 runs wrote report-tinker-<ts>.json while the prompt (and all other runs) use report-<ts>.json. Lexical globs like 'ls report-*.json | tail' then mis-order (report-tinker-* sorts after report-2026-*), which briefly misled this run's previous-report discovery. Cosmetic; both match the pre-push hook glob. Recommendation: future runs stick to report-<ts>.json (this run does) and discover the previous report by parsing timestamps, not lexical tail.
